title: Don't waste your money
body: I got this last year, and didn't use it, so after 2 months I canceled it...or so I thought. So at 4 months I canceled it AGAIN. no joy. Now the app won't even show the account, it just cycles and bails. Horrible customer service via AI. DO NOT GET APP.

title: Complicated and strange food
body: Waste of money! Wish I would’ve gone with another meal plan app. This app is complicated and the recipes are not to my liking. From the reviews it sounded like the recipes would simply generate and the food choices would be more basic. This app requires too many steps and the food combos are weird. I struggled to find more than a handful I liked.

title: Scam
body: They’ve been charging $20/ month and there is no way to cancel subscription, sign in to the account, or contact the company. I want my money back!!! Cancel my subscription!!!

title: App not working. Tells me to update, and then it doesn’t
body: App not working. Tells me to update, and then it doesn’t

title: Overpriced and deceptive
body: Glitchy and limited functionality. More to the point, signs you up to monthly billing even if just trying for one month and hides charges in the app.

title: Kept crashing, not accessible for me as a blind person but perfect idea
body: This looked to be the perfect solution to what I needed. However, as soon as I open the app, it keeps crashing. I’ve also found out through experimenting that it is not fully accessible with my screen reading software as a blind person. Many unlabeled buttons and I cannot drag and drop to add recipes. This is really sad because I would love to use this service.

title: Purchased app and its not working
body: I just purchased the app and its not working every time I log in it gives me an error! Total waste of money!

title: Impossible to cancel
body: I cancelled our subscription over 3 times and was continuing to still get charged! I emailed customer support after each time, several times and NO response no refund! If cancel it again and then sure enough, the next 1/4 I would get billed again. This has been such a frustrating process. Don’t sign up if you aren’t positive you’ll love it!

title: Worst experience
body: Honestly the food looks so much better than it taste . I don’t recommend this diet at all!!!

title: Disappointed
body: Very difficult to use

title: Needs Help
body: I will say, I’ve come from multiples meal planning and macro tracking apps which were very user friendly. This app is NOT that at all. Not even close. It is EXTREMELY confusing. It is a little more manageable if you do it on the website, but I downloaded the app for a reason. The leftovers is confusing if you’re trying to do it from the app. I also purchased the macro tracker thinking that it would track/show the macros for the meals I had planned for the week-it did not. I really want to love this app, but it is absolutely horrible in its user friendliness. I have never used an app or program where I felt so completely lost and confused as I did with this app. It is great for recipe ideas, but again NOT even close to subpar as a meal planning app. I’m regretful I spent as much as I did on this app.

title: Over priced
body: Got this app to try and it’s not as expected. Price is expensive and doesn’t give as many recipes/ranges as I thought. I find myself using a recipe more as an idea than an actual meal for my family. I’m googling other foods to make with some items off this app. Wish there were more options on editing the meal plans. After purchasing the app and trying it out I noticed they have a cookbook that most likely has the same recipes and a fraction of the price. I also saw that if you’re wanting more/different recipes, you have to purchase add ons…. For the first price paid for the app, it needs to have every recipe ever thought of. I did reach out for a refund but apparently I reached out 1 day late. 1 day. Don’t make the same mistake I did. Just buy a cook book or search super basic recipes that you can find anywhere else for free. Customer service doesn’t help just fyi. Was told mine was cancelled but they just cancelled the renewal.

title: Wanted this to be great but so disappointed!
body: I wanted to start the vegetarian whole 30 so this in theory seemed like the dream app but I was extremely disappointed and here’s why: 1. They automatically sign you up for auto renew and on the app it is hard to find how to change your subscription (not user friendly) and it does not come up on your Apple subscriptions if you have an iPhone. 2. It wouldn’t let me change the date of when I wanted to start it so my week had to start on a weds which isn’t what I wanted. 3. When I tried to change the amount of meals I wanted the meal to last as in leftovers for ththe next day but the recipe didn’t change. When you look on the support Center there are so many FAQs so seems like a lot of people have these issues or they are aware. Just seems like this is not that user friendly :/ and it’s not like I’m not tech savvy!

title: Don’t purchase this app, and then try to cancel, it won’t happen!
body: I cancelled the day after I purchased the app. I purchased for one month only at their monthly subscription rate of $24.99 monthly. The app clearly states your subscription renews until easy cancel The charge came through as $36.00. When I tried to call, I got a very strange message, then almost immediately received a text saying “How can I help you?” They messaged me that I had signed a two-year agreement so they couldn’t cancel or credit me. I never signed a two-year agreement. Their response was “ The good news is, you’ll really enjoy our service so the monthly fee will not be a concern.” I said I couldn’t wait to write a review on this and he sent me a nasty meme.. I have pursued this with my bank, but it is going to be an ongoing hassle!

title: NO MONEY BACK GUARANTEE
body: Cancelled subscription within hours, no refund despite several emails to support. Extremely frustrating.

title: Thought it was a good idea
body: The App version is difficult to use on my iPad, so I end up having to go out to the website if I want to try to use it. Very cumbersome and time consuming. Since I am the only person on a special meal plan, and many of the recipes are for multiple servings with no ability to adjust, it wastes time. If I add my own recipe, then I have to manually add the ingredients to the shopping list. Seems silly to include baked or fried bacon as a recipe. Waste of time and money. Will not renew and wish I could cancel and get pro-rated refund.

title: Frustrating, unhelpful and a waste of time -do not believe the 10 day free trial promise
body: If you use Apple to login to apps and hide your email as I do, you CAN NOT receive the ten day guaranteed money back refund. Their answer is “ask Apple for a refund”. You can not try their app without paying for it. Unless you are on Whole 30 I would recommend against using this app. My friend who recommended it does whole 30 and I definitely do not and found frustrating, unhelpful and a waste of time. Now I’m supposed to waste my time trying to get a hold of Apple what a joke.

title: No FODMAP choice
body: Really bummed. Had high hopes

title: Won’t allow me to cancel subscription
body: I signed up for the monthly subscription, but i don’t find it worthwhile. App won’t allow me to cancel the subscription. I want it canceled NOW!!!

title: No way to filter for dietary restrictions
body: You can set a filter for dietary restrictions, but the app will not change your meal plan.

title: Buyer Beware
body: Upon purchase I quickly realized this app wasn’t for me. You’re not able to control total calories and the company wants an extra $5/month to add macro tracking. I reached out to cancel because the company advertises a “10-day money back guarantee” but I was denied a refund because I purchased through the App Store. Not at all satisfied with the product or their handling of the response. Glad I only bought one month of access rather than a full year. I’ll be disputing this charge.

title: Repetitive recipes with little food variety
body: So disappointed with this “whole30 “ app. Second week beef hotdogs were on the menu. There isn’t anything wrong with a hotdog once in a while, but NOBODY buys an app so they can make a hot dog. Sweet potatoes are the side dish for every three meals. Healthy eating should be a variety of foods and certainly should not include processed meat. Need more vegetables in meal plan.

title: Wouldn’t recommend
body: Not even close to worth the amount of money they charge a year! When I first downloaded I was so excited I very quickly found out that it’s very repetitive. Most of the recipes are the same from week to week and is doesn’t even give you a full week of meals and recipes. After the first few weeks I never used it at all and some how missed it auto charging my bank for almost a year. When I realized this I emailed them to see if they would credit me back my last quarterly charge because I canceled it and haven’t used it. They credited me back half of one charge because of you want to cancel they charge you a 14 dollar administrative fee! Are you kidding me?!?! Most places are more then willing to credit more then one charge, these guys didn’t even offer and then charge a 14 dollar fee!

title: Endlessly Loads
body: Got the app to do the meal plans for a Whole30 month, it just endlessly loads the silly bowl of hearts when I try to load the required grocery lists or edit my profile, but the actual meal plan tab works somehow. Not a functional app.

title: Bummer about the onboarding
body: We’ll it’s not a great start. Just paid for a plan and down loaded the app, which is asking me to schedule a meal to unlock the rest of the app, which would be great IF I COULD GET THE SCHEDULER TO WORK. I’m really hopi h this gets fixed asap so I can actually try the app! Looks promising but total UX fail so far!!

title: You have to purchase
body: Boooooo!

title: Just wasted $13.99
body: Confusing app, can’t eliminate sugar, if you decide “classic” recipes can’t change to “Mediterranean” or “fodmap” - no choice for “GERD”

title: Need a version for the iPad
body: An app that is developed for an iPhone doesn’t always translate well to the iPad. I have vision issues and needed the bigger screen so downloaded to my iPad only to find that it’s the same size and the only option is vertical not horizontal.

title: Needs a lot of work
body: This app needs a lot of work! It makes Realplans more difficult to use. Even writing this review is hard because what I’m typing is in a white font on a white background Am unlikely to renew my plan.

title: Fodmap
body: If you are looking for a fodmap meal planner this is not for you. Prior to signing on, Fodmap is included in their advertising. Comes up in a fodmap search. Once I subscribed to the app there is not an option. I canceled immediately, within 5 minutes. Still looks like I’m in the hook for the month.

title: Waste of money
body: I’m disappointed that I paid for a year of this because the app is not working that well. Its full of bugs.. It’s extremely frustrating to import recipes because the app is not saving or confirming all of the ingredients. I had to do one ingredient at a time after trying for awhile. Importing one recipe took over an hour. For the existing recipes, the portion sizes I am changing are not saving and my shopping list is all over the place because of that. When you indicate that meal will be leftovers, it doubled my portion size of 4 to 8 but since I am cooking for 2, I didn’t need that much. I changed the recipe to portion sized for 2 and the leftover portion was automatically set for 4 and cannot be changed. Certainly getting the portion sizes correct are nothing short of a nightmare at this point. I’ll continue to try because I unfortunately paid for it but at this point, it’ll be easier to get out a piece of paper...

title: Full of bugs
body: I downloaded the app to use it for Whole30 meal planning. Within a few minutes of using it, it clearly had a bunch of bugs that made it unusable. I immediately emailed to get a refund and was told that they can not give me one. Don’t trust an app that doesn’t give you a trial period.

title: Recipes so basic a 4 year old could write them
body: I downloaded the app after it being recommended by a friend, I also downloaded a similar meal planning app and will definitely stick with the other one. I downloaded to make my life easier, to meal plan for me, so we could find new, creative recipes to get us out of the same routine. You can imagine my excitement when I created my first meal plan. My recipes consisted of- toast, scrambled eggs, green beans, Greek salad, avacado toast, chili, tuna salad, etc. This was so anti-climactic. Doesn’t live up to the hype, total waste of $. We will be using the other app.

title: Can’t get into app
body: Not sure if I was charged but I can’t get into the app. It won’t scroll down to the part that says I don’t have an acct and need to create one.

title: Would rate ZERO stars
body: I really wanted to like this app and company. However I didn’t use the app enough to keep and and canceled my subscription according to instructions given through the app. This was completed 2/10/20, 12 days before my subscription renewal date. Even after canceling my subscription well within adequate time, I am still being charged via PayPal for a subscription I have not had in almost two weeks prior to renewal. I have spent over FOUR HOURS contacting Apple, PayPal (and getting my cases for inappropriate charge denied), and real plans trying to resolve this issue. Both Apple and realplans have validated that I have no active subscription. Still waiting for my full refund and this issue to be resolved. Don’t waste your time or money. Unless you want to be charged for a service you opted out of unjustly.

title: Can’t create an account
body: The screen on the app won’t scroll so I can create an account. It only has a login. I will periodically try again but until I can login gets 1 star.

title: Avoid This App
body: The worst recipes what a waste of money.

title: App is poorly designed & recipes awful
body: Unfortunately there were at least 2 meals I had to completely throw out because the recipes were so inaccurate. Also, when I went to cancel the subscription the cancel button was so far down the page, after a long list of unwanted ads. Then there was no confirmation it canceled. Stuck with another month paying for horrible recipes.

title: Nope
body: Not user friendly. Not intuitive. Not for $13.99+ a month... Chat doesn’t work. Nutrition information not provided, apparently requires hunting down some macros tool which you won’t find...

title: THIS IS A SCAM
body: Don’t use this app. Total rip off.

title: Bad interface
body: The navigation on this app is not good. There is no way to easily go through and select what Diet to choose from, there are a few and what is good on one diet is not good on all. The menu selections are quite limited, and it tries to auto-populate a week at a time, without letting you select what to keep or what to remove. No iPadOS version (it is 2019 for cryin’ out loud!), way to expensive, and not intuitive at all.

title: Email not found
body: So I bought and paid for the whole 30 plan on this app. Received email confirming my payment. Tried to log in, and it’s telling me my email is not found, even though it populated when I went to sign in. I can’t find any information on how to talk to someone about this, since now I’ve wasted more than a day of my time. Super frustrating.

title: Fraudulent Billing
body: I attempted to buy an annual subscription last year - for some reason it didn’t go through. I was never able to login and support said I didn’t pay. I had to fight with Apple AND PayPal to get a refund and was a horrible ordeal. I decided eff this, the app isn’t worth this hassle. I got my money back and never used the app. Now, a year later, they KEEP trying to bill me, never mind that I never was able to login or use their crappy app to begin with. They also don’t show up under my subscriptions on iTunes, so it’s not like there’s anything to cancel. This is a SHADY company that 100% is trying to steal money.

title: No free trial
body: This app is an absolute joke. I tried to get the 14 day free trial and it literally just goes strait to the payment page. Now I’m trying to delete my payment info and I’m unable to because the app requires at least one payment be made. What a dumpster fire.

title: Cannot login
body: My payment on the app did not somehow get to real plans and now I was told to purchase the plan again and iTunes should not charge me? If your app can’t take payments from Apple properly why offer it? What a rip off!

title: Be cautious ...
body: It autorenews without warning, even if you have cancelled.

title: Wanted to try it...
body: but it won't even let me start my 14 day free trial offer. I put my information in and it just gives me a loading screen for a minute and never goes any further. Disappointing.

title: App not easy, charged me an extra quarter
body: Sadly, the app was not easy to make changes and actually use. I was able to do the 30 days thanks to the book recipes. Charged me for another quarter after cancellation. Would not recommend.

title: Not working
body: When I renewed my subscription through iTunes the money came out. But when I pull up the app, it just keeps saying I need to renew. I had problems with it the first time I tried it but I thought I would give it another chance. The chat ladies just keep telling me to re purchase it again and it will work. No I already paid over 20 bucks for the month why would I pay you again when you can’t even solve the problem from the start. So you can just keep collecting money for something that doesn’t work. Good luck trying to get anywhere. It doesn’t allow a refund either and any problems you report just sends you to their useless webpage. Chat is useless tried again, they will send an email in 24 hours. Useless. Horrible. Never again.

title: SCAMMY, buyer beware
body: I signed up with a ten day free trial period for my whole 30 diet. Five days in decided this app wasn’t working for my family so tried to cancel it. Many hoops to jump through, couldn’t do it from the app. Live chatted with an agent and asked her to cancel my account. She said she could help me with that but then proceeded to tell me how I needed to log into the account from a browser and request cancellation from the account page. Ok. Thanks for your “help?” Did that, and then made a time stamped screenshot....just in case. Logged in on Sunday to ensure it was canceled and it said it had been and that I would not be charged again. This morning was about to delete the app but logged in just to make sure it was canceled. To my surprise it wasn’t! Live chatted with another agent who said she was sorry my account cancellation hadn’t been processed when requested, that it would go to the free account after the month subscription was up, and then argued the semantics between account cancellation and refund request. Obviously if I am not going to use a service I want my money back!! I filed a claim with PayPal, hopefully it won’t be too much more of a headache to get a refund. My advice is to hope and pray you actually like this app if you try it, because getting your money back under the free trial period isn’t an easy process.

title: Horrible service/Cancellation nightmare
body: I did not receive assistance when asked. They only assumed. I left a message asking to be called and communication was only over email. False information is given on how to cancel the account. I had attempted to cancel through the app and could not find out how. Chat was not helpful and I was told to cancel through iTunes. This WAS not correct. Not worth the hassle to have this app. There are other apps and websites to get the information provided.

title: Signed up for Trial...
body: Went to sign into the app on the first day of my trial and put in my info and my credit card was charged. Okay. Fine. Put in my Nutritarian guidelines to get a meal plan...and looked at this week’s schedule. Nothing was populated. No recipes. There are recipes that populate the schedule under “Vegetarian”, but remove oils, dairy, and eggs and then...nothing. A waste of five minutes and $13.99.

title: Most recent upgrade is horrible
body: I loved this app when I first got it. It was very user friendly and made my meal planning and shopping so much easier and more efficient. The most recent upgrade to the app is so not user friendly that I’m considering canceling my subscription. I wish Real Plans would issue an “upgrade” that would take the app back to the previous version.

title: Does not work
body: I paid $33 fo this for a three month subscription on Dec 7th and it stopped working on Dec 23. It prompts you to log in and then says it doesn’t recognize your email. There is no recourse. Nobody to contact. It is a Colossal waste of money. Go out to dinner installed.

title: Very Dissapointed
body: The app itself is not the problem, I realized it is not for me. But to get the money back guarantee they advertise(30 days) using an iPhone is VERY DIFFICULT. I cannot believe the loop holes I must jump through and am very upset. I will be discouraging everyone I know not to get this app.

title: Not easy to use
body: I found this app too challenging to use. Plus, way to many different subscriptions depending on food. Then, when I went to unsubscribe I was given the wrong information and so ended up paying for 2 months I did not use. Because it was such a challenge to work with them, they got my money and I gave up. Hope it is really unsubscribes now.

title: Not a great meal planner
body: This whole mean planner is not intuitive and takes a lot of adjusting if you are someone who wants to meal prep for the week. It’s even less useful if you’re a single person.

title: Frozen
body: I can’t get past pressing and holding the fun pineapple cake for 1 second. It gets stuck there.

title: Limited meal plans/Unrealistic recipes
body: First, this is an app aimed at capitalizing on fad or highly specialized diets. Looking for a Mediterranean Diet plan? They ain’t got it. Apparently, the diet needs to be vital the past two years to qualify. Second, some of these recipes are not realistic for the average person. The health/fitness nut will do all of them but the average person will not and should not. Their lunch recipes are what most people would describe as a once a month nice dinner. It’s a means to make a buck. They googled a bunch of recipes and just threw them together and focused on the most recent viral fad diets. Don’t waste your time or money. They deserve neither.

title: Not user friendly
body: Not very friendly for allergies outside of the preselected groups.

title: Where is the try before buy?
body: I will not sign up for a subscription until I get a chance to use it, specially if it’s 99.99 a year. I’ll pass and read a book instead.

title: Not Free
body: This app is not free. Can’t even create an account or open it without paying for it first. And it’s EXPENSIVE

title: InApp Purchase
body: Nothing says this requires a purchase to use.

title: Infuriating
body: This app is glitchy, freezes up constantly, and once you decide you don’t want to use it anymore figuring out how to stop it from withdrawing $15 a month from your bank account is impossible. The app doesn’t show up under my subscriptions in the iTunes Store and I don’t see anywhere to discontinue my subscription from within the app itself. So I haven’t been using it for the past three months because of its poor performance but I’ve been paying for it against my wishes. I really wanted to like this app because the thought of having a grocery list generated for me sounded amazing. Unfortunately to use the grocery list you have to open and close the app constantly to get it to work properly. My advice is just buy the Whole30 books and steer clear of this irritating user experience.

title: Poor performance and not worth the money
body: Unaware that there were other products available, I used RealPlans for over a year. Routinely, ingredients would be left out of my shopping list, recipes would disappear and have to be re-entered, the mobile app was glitchy and would put ingredients back on the list after I had removed them, and the recipes provided were not good. Adding your own recipes was tedious given the lack of customization available and RealPlan’s requirement that you fill out superfluous information regarding the recipe for it to be saved. Finally, after using only 3 months of my one year subscription, they refused to offer a refund. Fortunately I found another service for half the price and twice the customization. Before you give RealPlans your money, try PLANTOEAT.COM, no hassle, fully refundable, and much better programming without all the glitches.

title: Can't cancel ever otherwise good
body: God help you if you ever want to cancel and you pay through Apple account. It's worse than dealing with an old fashion phone company or cable customer service. No joke. The hassle isn't worth it. Too bad. The app is otherwise good. Real plans says sorry, throws up hands and says call Apple. Guess what Apple says? Yup. Call real plans. Get the picture?

title: Terrible! Not realistic for busy moms!
body: Basically if your a chef, have one kid, and extra time on your hands, sure this could work. But if your a regular busy mom this will only add to your frustration! I was really hopeful that this would work. I am a busy mom with several kids and wanted something that would give me healthy meal ideas and take the work out of meal planning and grocery shopping. THIS IS NOT IT! First you have to pay just to try it out! So I downloaded the app and selected the one month option. Then I decided to jump on my computer so I could really look around only to find out it was less than half the price to try it through the website. I jumped on the chat and explained this to the customer service person....basically it was "sorry about your luck"! Ok, well I figured if this could really consolidate my meal prep time who cares about the savings. I set up my requirements to personalize my schedule...ex:for lunch I selected 15min prep, simple, kids... It came back with pan seared flank steak and scalloped potatoes, total prep time 30min and total cook time 2 hours!!😳 seriously! And every lunch meal was the same. Again I tried the chat with the customer service rep and asked if I was doing something wrong?? She said I had selected too many filters...umm..ok. She suggested I only select kids...basically the same kind of stuff! No busy momma has any kind of time for all that! I've already cancelled it. So basically I spent $14 to test it out for couple hours😔 Lesson learned never pay for something that doesn't let you try it first!!

title: No trial period, really?
body: There were super mixed reviews but I downloaded it hoping to try the recipes and app for a week before committing. Unfortunately there is no chance to try so I'm out....

body: not sure where these positive reviews are coming from...maybe friends? I search for a recipe I know is in the recipe box (Southwest Chicken Soup) and it comes up with no image. Just sort of freezes with nothing on the screen. Tried to import a recipe from the web on my phone, and the images are grainy and have nothing to do with the recipe. title: Love the idea but hard to use
