title: Expensive recipes
body: I’ve had RealPlans for a while. I will not be resubscribing. If you let the app plan your meals, they are time consuming and to buy that much food is expensive. Not happy with it.

title: Slow
body: App would be great if I didn’t have to wait 5 minutes anytime I need to make an update, delete / add a meal / or anything else on the app. Responsiveness of app is terrible.

title: Great idea, not so great execution
body: I would love to come back to this app in the future once more kinks have been worked out. It’s not very user friendly and there are a lot of little kinks that make use frustrating. Here are just a few examples for the staff to look into. I have only used blank-calendar planning mode, fyi. Mobile app: > I can’t figure out how to delete a meal without clearing the whole calendar. > Trying to import a recipe from a web page is a nightmare. It froze Safari several times and deleted everything causing me to start over. The information is not importing completely accurately which is fine, I can correct it, but there is no way to look at the actual recipe web page while doing so unless you open a separate browser program and then when you go back to the import tool it closes out and freezes up your browser app. I’m sure there are work arounds like importing the recipe needing work, then going back to the app and editing it, or importing directly from the app via a link (is there?) but I didn’t get that far because I was too frustrated. > Navigating the app is is just clumsy: >>When trying to search, my keyboard is in the way and the search results are in a small box hidden under the keyboard and there is no way to scroll them up. >> If don’t type the whole word correctly you get no results. For example I accidentally typed “Coffe”and there were no results, but when searching “Coffee” there were. >> When pulling up filters, etc. there is no way to exit if you change your mind unless you click “submit” or the like. —————————————— These are errors/annoying things about using the WEB and/or mobile version: > There is no “snack” slot on the calendar which would be great. > It was too confusing trying to plan meals for my husband and I because I needed to plan only breakfast, lunch, and snack for myself but dinner for the both of us. So selecting the “how many people to plan for” setting (I can’t remember the actual name of the setting) didn’t work for us. Adding leftovers was also confusing because it would change the serving size. If I add a meal that makes 4 servings, I would expect I could add it to the calendar 4 times, but when dragging and adding as a left over it would just add more servings which makes no sense. I’m expecting this is user error but when I went to the support page I couldn’t find any help in this area. > Some stuff just gets *stuck* and buttons won’t work. For example when changing serving size I could only increase the size and never go back down. I mean I could increase from 4 to 20 (as a test) and then the - (minus) button wouldn’t work, so I would have to delete the whole recipe entry and start over. There are more little things but this is what I can think of now. I requested a refund shortly into my trial because I could just tell it was going to be too frustrating for me to get it to work the way I needed so I will go back to excel. Great idea, poor execution and the $15/mo subscription is high for me to use something that only kind of works.

title: App misleading
body: I got this app because I thought it was part of the whole30 program and today I found out it’s not part of the whole30 programs🤬🤬🤬🤬. So I have wasted my money on this. This popped up when I sign up for the starter kit. They should say that they’re not part of Melissa’s whole30 program but it’s a tool to use if you want too. I wish I could get a refund for the remaining amount of time that I won’t be using this app.

title: Glitchy
body: Had a really bad experience with this app. The set up and grocery list function is not intuitive, and makes it hard to track. Many of my “favorited” meals disappear and are no longer highlighted. I unsubscribed. Save your money and just google whole 30 recipes.

title: Great Idea, Terrible Mobile App
body: Being new to following an AIP diet, I was glad to find Real Plans to help me get started. The computer interface is pretty good, however, I am rarely at my computer and this mobile app is awful, practically unusable - or at least cumbersome enough to not make it worth my time. Surely for the amount of money I paid for a subscription they could have developed something much better than this. I will be canceling.

title: Stopped working
body: After I purchased a year this app it stopped working completely. It won’t stay open. I will open it and then it kicks me out completely. I have offloaded it and reloaded it many times. Updated my phone etc. but I can’t use it at all. I gave it to stars because it worked great when I was using the monthly version. It was working fine when I was paying monthly. Right after right after I paid for the whole year at stopped working?

title: Decent app, was charged despite free trial offer
body: App offered a 14 day free trial for the paid version, but I was charged the full monthly fee immediately. Of course the charge goes through Apple, so their customer service was able to just pass the buck and never even answered me as to why I was charged with the trial. The app is ok - I may have kept it were I not put off by the charge issue, though probably not. There are some good recipes, but it doesn’t allow much flexibility or account for those shopping on a budget at all. The shopping lists were enormous, with many specialty ingredients and very little overlap so you would have needed to get much more than you actually needed of many items. If more options for budget ranges or efficient use of ingredients were built in, the app could have potential.

title: Good in theory
body: I used this app 3 years ago and I liked it, but trying it with the updates is really upsetting me. It is glitchy, it is slow, and the recipes it generates are ridiculous most of the time. I wanted to use it for another round of Whole30, but there doesn’t seem to be a way to have it generate a weekly plan that includes enough protein in meals. I have had to go in to each day and edit every meal that it generates. Sorry, but “apple with almond butter” isn’t a sufficient breakfast, nor is “baked sweet potato” a sufficient dinner. There needs to be a way to control the amount of protein someone wants aside from taking the time to go and edit everything that it generates. I’m spending more time using this “time saving app” than I was just meal planning on my own with pen and paper. Total waste of money.

title: Glitches
body: I use the app daily, I love all the recipes and food. It’s helped me even loose weight and look forward to cooking. However I have had issues with the app randomly canceling my subscription, making me pay double and locking me out of my account. For example I was about to cook dinner tonight and the app locked me out and said I needed to renew my subscription. When I clicked to renew my subscription it wouldn’t allow me to resubscribe because it was registering that I am already subscribed however it won’t allow me onto the app anyways with out purchasing the more expensive subscription along with my current one. So now I have everything to make dinner but no recipe and can not find the recipe online...... I contacted online support and haven’t heard anything back. Their customer service isn’t very good and they don’t take responsibility for the app not working. Last time this happened they told me they couldn’t help and I needed to contact the Apple store. When I contacted the Apple Apple store (on the phone) they confirmed that it was Real Plans responsibility for the app having issues. Thankfully the gal on the phone for Apple ended up finding a way to help me.

title: So much potential
body: I previously used this service and although it was often difficult to navigate I found some great recipes. However, I recently decided to use it again to do the whole30. In addition to charging a monthly fee they are now also charging for programs. The only reason I ever considered using them in the first place was because they were endorsed by the Whole30 and the fact that they've started charging so much more for that program doesn’t seem like a coincidence. Even this I could have moved past but many of the recipes I had saved have been erased which defeats why I decided to use it again. All in all the company fails to update customers on changes that allow us to decide if this is the right platform. It is again difficult to navigate and dangerously close to being exorbitantly overpriced. Furthermore, many of the recipes seem to be submitted so the clients are doing some of the heavy lifting. How are these prices and the other app failures then justifiable?

title: Expensive and Not Effective
body: The plan cost which is not the biggest problem but the grocery list is crazy expensive. Meal plans don’t include consist meal types during the weeks so you’re spending a ton on food. The app help chat feature doesn’t work and I’ve cancelled this plan but it’s still trying to charge me and because the app cliches i can’t fix it.

title: Refresh Bugs
body: I purchased the Whole 30 plan. When adding recipes, they don’t appear on the planning schedule. In order to make them appear, I have to scroll all the way to the top and pull down to refresh the app/data. That adds 10-20 seconds each time I add a recipe. Also, when using the shopping lists and indicating that I already have an ingredient, often times, after marking it, it will reappear at a later time as unmarked. Frustrating. These are very basic app/service refresh design issues that shouldn’t appear in a $30 purchase, $15/mos subscription.

title: Unable to cancel subscription
body: I followed the guide for canceling the subscription but the subscription doesn’t show up in my Apple ID however a payment still came out of my account for it I am not using the app and I do t know what to do to cancel please help.

title: Frustrating
body: The idea of this app is fantastic. Some of the recipes were quite good. My issue lies in some of the glaring mistakes that I discovered after 3 months of using the app. Firstly, the nutritional information seemed to sometimes be for the entire recipe, and sometimes for one serving. I confirmed this by running some of the recipes though other nutrition programs. This is frustrating for people who want to closely track nutrition. Secondly, going through the trouble of entering in dietary restrictions apparently made no difference to the recipes offered. After restricting my diet to gluten free and Keto, my meal plan was riddled with sandwiches. What? Finally, I purchased an “integrated” macros tracker that turns out wasn’t even available on the app. You had to use it with the website only. Just...ugh. I got too frustrated to keep paying for it. TLDR; nice idea, terrible execution

title: Where’s the add ingredient?
body: I’ve been using this app for some time and loved it but with the new update I can’t add a single ingredient and have it add to my shopping list. The only options it gives me are recipes and notes. Please add the “add ingredient” back.

title: What is happening?
body: I used to love this app. However, for the last couple of weeks my app does not start up. I have to delete the app and then download it daily. I think it’s time to quit it and move on. I cannot be this frustrated with something I enjoyed so much before!

title: Difficult to use
body: I tried this app for the Whole Food 30 meal plans; I found it difficult to use; I didn’t see a built in tutorial; I had a couple of chats with the support team and they were helpful. I decided this app wasn’t for me.

title: Great for the shopping list.
body: But the recipes are just ok. I found better recipes online.

title: Shopping List not Working
body: I love using Real Plans to plan my weekly meals and manage my grocery list. In the last few weeks the shopping list seems to be struggling. Either it has a syncing issue and will ask if I want to sync with the network or discard changes, or it doesn't save at all. I just got back from the grocery store and every time I checked something off, it would reappear a minute later. Makes it difficult to keep up with your list when you can't check anything off.

title: Meal plan is great, app is not
body: One major factor for turning me on to RealPlans was the fact I could use a mobile app and sync it with an online server so that I may plan my meals on my computer. The idea was that I could then use my phone in the grocery store as a shopping list and buy all my ingredients. I just realized that the recipes and serving sizes do not sync up correctly. When I had 3-4 servings marked for each meal, my shopping list on my phone populated as if each meal were only one serving (which i did not initially notice because I had multiple chicken-based meals and so I thought the amounts were reasonable). Therefore I obviously did not buy enough ingredients for my meals this week, which is very frustrating. I have also noticed the app to freeze up several times after syncing "changes" with the server. I may just cancel my subscription because of this buggy app.

title: Has potential but if an app doesn't load...
body: I like the Whole30 plan for guiding healthy eating choices by providing easy, in depth shopping lists and customizable menus. But I have found the app doesn't load. At all, sometimes. And then even attempting to reinstall fails. An app is only as good as its consistent usability. What's even more annoying is if I try to access the web based whole30 dashboard from my phone it forces me to use the app—the app which won't load. When and if this issue is fixed, I'll happily rate higher, as the content is great, but the delivery method is well, broken.

title: Love the concept but need print capabilities
body: I've been a customer for going on two years now and while I love the concept and recipes, I'm disappointed at the lack of functionality within the app. All the customizations and print capabilities have to be done from a computer, which is terribly inconvenient for this busy working mom of three littles. They won't even let you login the full site from your phone, which adds insult to injury. Fix this and you'll have a loyal customer. Without it, I'm done when my subscription ends.

title: Monthly plan purchase required
body: The details provided about the app is a bit deceptive. Once you download and open, you are immediately required to purchase a plan. There is no way to view what it is or has to offer. I had to Google their name and check out their actual website. Based on the website intro, I decided to purchase a monthly membership to try it out. The other issue is the app is glitchy- very much so. If you want to see your week in advance, the app closes. If you want to change how to set your week, an error message pops up and you have to close the app and restart. You are forced to use the website version which is not intuitive, easy to navigate, or faster. However, the recipes are very are good- real food, clean ingredients. And you can create your own meal plan or modify the auto generated one to your liking. It also provides a selection of what to serve your meal with- sides. That was what I was looking for. There are in-app purchases available, for $3 more a month, to add Whole30, Nom Nom Paleo, PaleoOMG, and other well known healthy food blogger recipes. You can also upload your own. Overall, the concept and content is great, but the technology does it no justice. I will try a month of it and see if its worth waiting for greater enhancements to app and website.

title: Just reviewing app
body: I want to start by saying that I love real plans as a whole. I use it every week. This review is solely for the app. I like the look of the latest update. Here are my thoughts to make it a bit better- allow the app to stand alone without having to log onto a computer to add items to grocery list and modify the meal plan. I usually do all that over coffee while sitting on my couch, lol. I believe there is a little bug in the latest update. The app doesn't default to today's date when it is opened, rather it stays on the last meal used. Just a bit confusing. So again, overall, love this program! Makes my life easier. Just please, somehow, take away the online necessity.

title: Love but crashing
body: App keeps crashing when I try to update schedule! I’m on a 13 with latest iOS

title: Not worth paying for
body: I’m pretty disappointed in the lack of variation with the algorithm for formulating weekly meal plans. Every week I have to erase everything and recalibrate it because it gives me hardly any variations of meals and I get the same recipes repeatedly. I stopped following the weekly meal plan and just go through and find recipes, which is not what I paid for. Wouldn’t recommend paying for this, I will not be resubscribing after my subscription ends.

title: No food allergy filtering
body: Not what I was looking for. There’s no way to filter out recipes that contain my allergies.

title: Repeating meals, not a lot of options
body: I’ll preface this with, I came from the major meal planner service, which has a ton of developers and recipe makers, tons of recipe options, easy to use app. The drawback was that there wasn’t an option to do AIP or at least remove nightshades, which is an allergen in our household, and 90% of their recipes contain and NEED tomatoes. Being on this allergy trip for a few years, I do have a few swaps up my sleeves (pumpkin purée takes on the flavor of tomato sauce, fyi), but I was getting tired of constantly omitting the tomatoes. So I decided to try real plans. I liked the idea of it, i loved that I can dial in our allergens. There’s a huge list in the settings that I can select or deselect to get the curated foods set directly onto the weekly meal planner. My major major dislike is that the recipes are now repeating, less than a month later, there’s not really much to choose from in general, so there’s not a lot of recipes I can swap in now that we’ve seen a lot of the recipes. And while the kids enjoyed almost all of the recipes from the other service even with me swapping ingredients out, they have been less than enthusiastic about each meal with Real Plans. We’ve only favorited two meals this month out of many. The idea behind this app and planning service is fabulous but the execution and the options just isn’t there, and I wouldn’t have paid as much as I did to sign up had I known.

title: Website is better
body: I find the website so much easier to use. On the app, my grocery list often gives me wrong items so I end up having to get groceries multiple times. Last night I ordered groceries online, which is already time consuming. The generated list has the items, but you have to double check the quantity of everything. Last week I got 1 russet potato for a recipe that called for 6. After I get my groceries, I go back to the app to check them off the list. Today, when I opened the app to figure out what I still need, it had marked some of it “already have” and there was a whole list of new items. I panicked for a moment thinking it had generated a new plan for the week - it had. I triple checked that I was looking at the correct week’s list and menu. When I went to the website, the correct plan and grocery list is there. That’s a relief, but also frustrating because the website and the app aren’t communicating the way the should. Also, the website is almost impossible to use on a mobile phone. I should keep track of the number of hours I spend just getting groceries for the week. Otherwise, it’s nice to have the convenience of a meal planner so I don’t have to make a menu and grocery list on my own. That it not a talent I possess.

title: Works ok, but limited recipes and has glitches
body: I downloaded for Whole30, and while it has been helpful, the recipe selection is very limited (and most are not appetizing to me), leaving me to import recipes from other websites. This import feature is VERY glitchy. The recipes don’t save, I get errors, etc and am wasting a lot of time trying to reimport. Also, I hate that there is no option to designate leftovers to a certain day/meal when entering your own recipes.

title: App not as friendly as the computer
body: Love Real Plans, but the app has a long way to go to catch up to the computer version, especially for people who import recipes.

title: Good features, but not good sync
body: Decent app overall, but fails at being a robust multi-user or offline-first app. Good luck trying to use the shopping list feature with your partner, or in a store that squelches your cellular coverage. It’s fine superficially, but constant pull-to-refreshes that even then don’t consistently show your shopping list’s true state gets frustrating quite quickly. Also, this app follows the "beg for reviews" anti-pattern, so here we are. Friends don’t let friends’ apps block the world for this kind of thing.

title: App used to be better
body: The app is confusing now. I miss the “shelf” when I wanted to shift meals. It’s also confusing pulling up the next’s menu or shopping cart that I’ve already planned. I’ve accidentally overwritten the meal plan just trying to access the menu or plan outside of the current week. Questioning if it’s still worth the $10+/mth I pay.

title: Falls short
body: The concept of this app is wonderful and I LOVE the recipes I have tried thus far. But, isn’t there always a but, I planned an entire week worth of meals, went through the grocery list, took out the things I already owned and went shopping! Great so far. The first day was fantastic, everything I needed was there, the recipes were easy to follow and the results were great! Then day two. Scallops was on the menu. But scallops were not on the shopping list! No scallops. Ok, maybe I missed it or clicked “I have” by mistake. Push scallops to day three and we’ll eat day three meal today. No cauliflower rice! Cauliflower was on the list and I got it, but no cauliflower rice. Next recipe. No coconut milk! Now I am annoyed. It is a wonderful idea and I love the concept but I was looking for something that would organize me enough so I would have all the ingredients and not need to go to the store at 6 when i get home from work and start cooking.

title: Love the app, not the 2019 update
body: I’ve used this app for a while now and have generally found it really useful for meal planning. I love the new interface with Instacart as well. That said, the bulk of the changes made in the 2019 update have made the app far more cumbersome to use and are less user friendly. The app has been considerably slower and the layout is less convenient. It is harder to pull recipes from past weeks without searching for them again and it is more difficult to browse through recipes if I don’t know exactly what I’m looking for. I still love the app but wish they would return to the old layout as it was quite a bit easier to use.

title: Good but needs tweaks
body: The recent update was a mixed-bag. The biggest thing I liked is they added the ability to “favorite” recipes that you like. However they changed the interface so it’s now harder to view the week’s menu and move/change recipes around, especially on the phone app where I usually do the meal planning. Trying to move a recipe to a different day is a Herculean task where as before the recipe stayed in place while you scrolled the calendar. The app only needed a couple of minor tweaks, but they changed several things for the worse.

title: Needs iPad Version
body: Says it is compatible with iPad but it doesn’t come up in apps on the iPad.

title: I love this app but this update is not working.
body: Every time I open the app, it says I need to update, but when I click on "update" on this screen, it takes me to the App Store abd only allows me to "open" the app again which starts a vicious cycle. Once in a while I can swipe the notice to update to get to the content but not always. Please correct this asap!

title: Not Enough Recipes
body: The app is definitely beautiful, and pretty easy to navigate. We were disappointed in the variety of recipes needs. If I want an easy weeknight dinner, or a dairy-free dinner that doesn't cost a fortune, I get like 4 options. It looks like there are a lot of recipes on here, until you start adding filters. Then it drops dramatically. It was t worth the $$ for us.

title: App is cool but.....
body: The app is cool, when it works, which was about 3 days for me. Now every time I try to open it, it gets stuck on a page telling me I need to update it, even though it has the newest update.

title: Needs bug fixed
body: While I love this app and the recipes, the app shuts down every time a search for a recipe. I can't look up the recipe for OMG BBQ sauce for our chicken burgers tonight. :( tried the website and can't be accessed from my phone, either. Bummer.

title: Not thrilled
body: I was excited to receive a subscription to this program as a gift. I love all of the healthy recipes, and the variety of foods is definitely a plus for sticking to a healthy eating lifestyle. Unfortunately, the app is not that user friendly. They need to have easy features for adding one recipe at a time to the shopping list. Hopefully, they fix up some of these issues before my subscription expires!

title: Okay. Needs work.
body: This app shows your menu for the week, the recipes available in your recipe box, and allows you to bring up your grocery list. That's it. It really needs more functionality. Ideally, I'd like it to be able to import all of the recipes that I find almost daily on the web. I realize it's tricky, given that Paprika still has issues doing that well, and it's been one of their main functions for years. It would also be nice to be able to do some editing within each recipe, so adding and removing tags, and categories, for example.

title: Helpful, but slow
body: I really want to like this app. Real Plans is wonderful, but I downloaded this app to use the shopping list function. But it is frustratingly slow. If I am on a store list, and tap to cross off an item, there is a full five second delay before the item changes color and disappears. If I am on the main list that is not segregated by stores or by category, I can tap and it instantly changes color, but does not disappear. Which is useless. Who wants to continually scroll up and down a list looking for things that you haven't gotten crossed off? I'm also very disappointed by the lack of recipe adding. I don't always want to have to login on my computer to add items, as I'm usually on the go and would rather just use my phone. Over all this app could be fantastic, but it's just not there yet.

title: Love the idea.
body: The instructions are simple and organized but every time I try to search for recipes in the recipe box, nothing shows up.

title: Almost Perfect
body: I love how easy it is to schedule meals, whether it’s a recipe from the app or one that I’ve imported. I love how it generates a shopping list for me and how I can check things off as I’m shopping. My biggest complaint is a recurring problem. I have gluten free bread scheduled for my shopping every week. Every once in a while, it disappears completely from the list and I have to add it again. Even though it is a weekly item, I have actually forgotten to purchase it when it has disappeared from the list, which is very annoying. The whole point of scheduling weekly recurring items is so that I don’t have to think about them every week.

title: Great shopping lists!
body: I love the shopping list feature!! It was fantastic at simplifying the changes I needed to make in my shopping to accommodate the Low FODMAP diet. Just wish there was a bit more variety and new recipes published more often.

title: Great healthy foods
body: We originally bought this to help navigate whole 30. As busy parents with full time jobs, we have continued this app faithfully for over two years. The organization and good meals helps us to stay away from easy junk food and makes shopping SO MUCH EASIER! We would like more variety for side dishes that our teens also like, but overall this has been a game changer for our family!

title: Serving size for nutritional info?
body: This is a great app, has really helped me stay on track and is fun to use. My only gripe is that when you go to nutritional information, I don’t think there is a serving size listed. Neither is the serving size mentioned in the recipe. (For example, in the Bacon and Beef patties, it does not say “Form into 4 patties.” It just says “form into patties.”) This makes a difference to those of us trying to count calories. A recipe will say it’s “320 calories” but for what? 4 ounces? 1/4 of the recipe? You have no idea. If this were fixed it would be a 5 star app for sure.

title: App is not as versatile as the website
body: I think most people go to Real Plans for Whole30 options. I definitely did. But I spent most of my time on the website. The website allows the pantry option and is all-round easier to use. The biggest wish I have is a better way to do the re-integration Slow Roll option. I wish there was an option to choose how long you wanted to do the re-integration and to choose the days for example, the website talk about starting with relaxing sugars in sauces, like re-adding ketchup instead of starting with legumes. Just more streamlined and sleek is what I am wishing for right now.

title: Great idea, customized settings are buggy
body: Like this app but advanced settings (food exclusions, tags) often don’t take. Had to get support to reset from their end. After that I just had to fiddle with different settings hoping something would trigger an overwrite. I subscribed to the whole 30 plans.

title: iPhone app messed up my online plan
body: I set everything up online using the website, including types of food I wanted to exclude. Had a great meal plan, then I logged in using the app and it made me go through the entire set up process again and changed my entire meal plan. That was pretty frustrating. The service itself is great, though.

title: Yummy Food
body: The recipes are delicious and I’m enjoying the app. One thing I don’t like is there isn’t a way to share the recipe.

title: Real plans is a 5 but Whole 30 option a 2
body: I bought Realplans instead of using a free meal planning app because of the option to have planning for my dry January Whole 30. Once my learning curve flattened out I really enjoy using Realplans. The app is great for the shopping list, I like the variety of meal options. It has made my food life easier. However, paying an extra $30 for a Whole 30 isn’t worth it at all. You get access to 328 Whole 30 recipes, but the majority of the planned meals weren’t from Whole 30. I own 4 of their books and many of those recipes aren’t on the website. She uses lemon garlic dressing in a lot of her meals and searching for lemon garlic dressing in the recipe box, nothing comes up. I had a lot of repeat side dishes, like sweet potato mash, nothing using leftovers in a repeat meal. I ended up choosing my own Whole 30 meals which I didn’t need to pay extra for. Also my 10 day reintroduction plan didn’t work at all. I chatted with support who told me to add my own recipes. Well, yea, but that’s not what I paid $30 for. 4 days later, I’m still waiting to hear from them. So, Realplans? Yes Whole 30 option? NO. You can plan it on your own.

title: Great meal planning service for clean-eating
body: This has greatly improved our scope and variety of food, especially as we are seasonal eaters and tend to have the same food over and over. The only issue is there always seems to be bugs in the app, and there are a few things that could be made to work a bit more simply. Great variety of recipes though and the option to also import your own!

title: Real plans
body: I like the iphone app. Need an Ipad version.

title: Real Food
body: App provides meal plans using real food. For anyone trying to eat healthier, it's a great tool. App is free, but you need to purchase meal plans. I would give this 5-stars, but am not thrilled with the shopping list. It need to be more specific- recipe called for red apple, list just said apple which makes a difference. Also needs to use real measurements- how do I buy 1/4 cup carrots? Please just tell me how many, and what size, of carrots to buy. Finally, use common terms for food. Galangal? What the heck is that? Oh, it's ginger - why couldn't they just add ginger to the list? Would have saved some emergency Googling at the store. All in all, am happy with the app and am eating much better.

title: The Best Meal Planning and Grocery List App
body: Real Plans is the best meal planning app I have ever used. The app has all the features of the site, is easy to use, and is practically limitless in what it can do. I tend to use the website on my desktop for planning out the week, and making adjustments on the go with my mobile app if needed. But if I'm pressed for time, I can create my entire plan with the app on the way to the grocery store—without lacking any features from the full site, which are truly amazing. In addition to preset diets (paleo, traditional, gluten-free, etc) I can exclude food groups and specific foods for a completely personal diet of my own creation! I can also set the number of servings for the weekly plan, so that every recipe will be adjusted to yield the proper amount, whether I'm cooking for myself, my family, or a whole dinner party. The recipes included are fantastic, with a great variety. But if I'm in the mood for something different, I can add new recipes effortlessly (However, I believe importing recipes is only supported on the website). If this app had nothing but the grocery list alone I would get it just for that. Absolutely dynamic, the Real Plans grocery list is the easiest, most efficient grocery list I've ever used. The app does all the work for me, automatically adjusting ingredients and quantities when I make changes to the meal plan. If I want to add something extra that is not used in a recipe, I can manually edit anything on the list, adjusting quantities, adding items, setting items to buy on a schedule, even setting what stores to buy items from! Once my list is perfect, I can take it with me anywhere, marking off items as I get them. No need to write, rewrite, and eventually lose my shopping list. If all this weren't enough, the app also includes the timeline, showing you when you need to start defrosting ingredients, setting the slow cooker, or preparing ingredients like sauces, broths, and marinades ahead of time. This is where the elusive fifth star comes in. While the timeline is a handy feature, it's only useful if you remember to look at it. I confess, I usually forget about it. If the Real Plans app had a widget for the control center—or even better: timeline push notifications—I would not hesitate to bestow a shining five-star rating. In truth, timeline push notifications are such a small thing to hold back this wonderful app by a whole star. If I could give it 4 1/2 or even 4 3/4 I would. But it is not quite perfect, so for now it is deserving of all four of the stars I have given it.

title: So much easier this time with this app!
body: I’ve done whole30 before and it’s night a day with this app! I love you can say when you want to cook and when you want leftovers! Of course you can pick your meals but having them start with something helped my decision fatigue and everything they’ve suggested I’ve loved!

title: Just do it
body: My lifestyle and relationship with food is so much healthier as a result of this app’s Whole30 compliant automated meal planning that’s easy to edit with personal preferences. After choosing my meals and leftovers, a shopping list is automatically created making our weekly trip to the grocery store so much more efficient.

title: Update
body: Just downloaded the app and was excited to get my grocery list together because I head down the mountain today to run errands. There is apparently an update which won’t let me access my list at the moment and when I click on Update to go to the App Store the Update button does not show. So I can’t update the app and I can’t access the app until I update. Help!

title: Foundational
body: This is the missing piece to my meal planning foundation!! I’ve been focused on nutrition for over two decades (I’m a Registered Nurse, Integrative Nutrition Coach and soon to be AIP Certified Coach) and I ALWAYS fall down around meal planning!! Until now. I am super pumped to have this tool in my arsenal of self-care. And the customer support is TOP-NOTCH!!! Try this app, you will LOVE it!

title: Awesome Ap
body: Just met with Anthony to show me how to use the ap! Highly recommend, it was so helpful. You can do so much with this ap! Here I come 2025, healthier me. Great resource!

title: Confusing at first, but great app support
body: I’m using Real Plans with Whole30. I clicked through some pages on the Whole30 website, but accidentally purchased the wrong version of Real Plans and was disappointed when I didn’t see Whole30 as an option under “diet type”. I reached out to support, and they were quick to respond and scheduled a zoom call with me to walk through their platform. The zoom call was with Antony. He was lovely to chat with and took the time to show me exactly how to use the platform the way I wanted to. Excited to use the shopping list and cooking mode features during my Whole30 journey 😊

title: Easy to use and takes feedback!
body: I discovered Real Plans a few months ago, and it is exactly what I was looking for - new recipes, easy to plan with leftovers, macro consideration, and a shopping list all in one! Plus they are integrated with some of my favorite recipe creators, and it’s easy to import your own. I provided feedback asking if we could have access to planning a few more weeks out - we order our meat monthly from our local farm, so this would help immensely. They took that to their dev team and made the update! Thank you for making mealtime much easier! Love all of the customization tools as well to fit any diet, schedule, and cooking level.

title: Great app; amazing customer support
body: This is my second time using Real Plans. I found the Low FODMAP plan a couple years ago when I was having health issues and the app was a lifesaver- it saved me from having to spend hours researching recipes and ingredients. I had a week’s worth of meals in a few moments. I actually saw my symptoms improve by following the meal plan! Unfortunately I started having health issues again so I turned to the app for support. I created the meal plan and used the grocery list to do all my shopping. So easy! But the next day (a Sunday) I discovered all the recipes I had planned for had disappeared! I realized a new week had populated and I could not find the week I had planned for. Upset, I emailed customer service and complained, not expecting a reply til the next day at the earliest. I was so surprised that within an hour of my email I had a call back from a real person! Antony understood my frustration and patiently walked me through finding the week of meals I had planned for. I am definitely glad I renewed my subscription and am truly grateful for the support!

title: Easy and comprehensive
body: Real plans is by far the best collection of menus that generates shopping lists automatically. You can filter by type of diet (I use the Whole30 one), and services really good and creative, recipes along with preparation time step-by-step instructions. I have been using it for three years now and can’t imagine creating my weekly menus without it!

title: Loving this
body: I’m doing the whole 30 minus nightshades and I can choose from easy to budget to more complicated meals. The shopping and pantry lists are awesome. Right now I’m cooking four days a week and using leftovers for the rest of the days. Although this next week, I’m cooking a little bit longer. Sometimes meal prep like this morning took two hours for breakfast for 5 days. It wasn’t difficult, there is just a lot of fresh herbs that I had to take off the stems. It takes a long time. I feel better and I’m losing weight. And it’s good to know that after I cook lunch with enough leftover for the rest of the week and then dinner with enough leftover for the rest of the week, my work week is gonna be so much easier. But yes, I do spend most of all day Sunday cleaning, cooking, cleaning cooking, cleaning, cooking … it is definitely not a lazy day. But I do get to rest in between. Yesterday at the farmers market was fun, but sometimes I’ll just go to Winco or Chuck’s to get some of the fruits and veggies. My blood sugar is down my resting heart rate is down. My walking Heart rate is down and my blood pressure is down. I know what I’m putting in my food.

title: Fantastic App
body: I love how easy it is to use Real Plans app. The food is delicious and it has helped me to stick to eating healthy food. Bravo Real Plans!

title: First two weeks
body: Things are going great and the scheduled meals mean one less thing to think about each day. And you know you will have what you need because of the shopping list. We also appreciate the simple ingredients and uncomplicated recipes.

title: Convenient
body: This app is great at providing usually delicious meals especially when you are bound to limited ingredients due to food allergies. Took me a couple days to get used to using the app efficiently however that could be said for most apps.

title: Excited for all the Low Fodmap recipes!
body: I recently downloaded Real Plans and am SO excited for all of the Low Fodmap recipes available! I’m still navigating dealing with acid reflux and what foods are okay to eat, so having this meal plan and already made grocery list will make eating feel a lot less stressful again. I’m also so excited for all of the other types of meals available since my husband doesn’t necessarily need to eat a Low Fodmap diet.

title: Great tool!
body: Just started using this app and loving it! It is helping tremendously with meal planning for Whole30. My last Whole30 was overwhelming trying to hunt for recipes to meal plan week by week, on top of food prep. Which might be why it’s been a few years (or more) since my last one! 😆 This app does the meal planning for me. It includes the shopping list of items you need for that week and you can even search recipes for food you have on hand. This purchase has been worth it and proving to be an invaluable tool!

title: Give this one a try.
body: Nice plan to take the guess work of what recipes are compliant with the plan you are following.Love the shopping list and the nightly reminders to prepare for the next days meal. Most meals do not take long to cook but you do need to make time to prepare. We are following the Whole30 plan this time around. My husband is a big guy and seems satisfied with the portions. There are several recipes that I will incorporate into regular non-plan meals such as the Garden Veggie Quiche. We took our measurements and weight on day one and will not weigh again until 30 days are done.

title: Gamechanger
body: Fabulous recipes, clear instructions. Makes it so easy to eat well.

title: Definitely Give This App A Try!
body: This app has been so helpful! I totally rely on it now. I’m a pescatarian and my family eats meat so it’s just nice to have such an organized tool for creating fun recipes that suit everyone. I also love the shopping list feature because it saves me a lot of time and basically guarantees I don’t forget anything at the store. The other cool thing about it is you can either use it like a simple meal planning app or you can really dig in and use some more of the complex features it offers. Anyways, I totally recommend it! It has become a staple for our family.

title: Keeping me keeping on.
body: This app is absolutely the reason I am having such an easy time with my Whole30 diet reset. From the weekly grocery list to recipes that are so simple yet amazingly delicious to leftovers that give me a break from cooking the next day-Real Plans is MAKING me successful! Thank you to Whole30 for such perfect support.

title: Makes AIP delicious and so much easier
body: Recipes so far are great. Shopping list. Add to instant cart or fresh. AIP is a transition by itself. This app helps so much!

title: Love Real Plans!!!
body: Couldn’t live without it!! Keep up the good work. I love that I can get many many delicious recipes for my gluten-free diet. Thanks so much!!!

title: Where have you been all my life
body: I’m suffering from multiple health issues which means eating healthy is not an option, but I have 4 kids 6, 5, 4, &2! Life is crazy so meal planning is tough especially with such a specific diet! This not only helps plan but is so detailed down to specifying particular foods to avoid on top of a regular diet! I’m so thankful!!

title: Almost Perfect
body: Love using RealPlans for meal planning. So handy to have it right on my phone so if I need to change something up while at the grocer it’s no big deal and I know exactly what to add or take away from the list. Only hiccup is that for some reason it doesn’t work as well when I want to shop for two weeks at a time. Even if I prepare the lists for each week separately (i.e. make of the things I already have, etc), when I combine the two lists into one before going into the grocery it often puts stuff back on the list that I already marked off, and won’t let me check off some things after I purchase. Kind of annoying, especially since I often shop for 2 weeks at a time. But otherwise, I love this app!

title: Love if!
body: I live the ease and convenience of these meal plans. I’m not a very good cook but I can make these recipes and they taste great!

title: Game changer
body: I love how easy this app makes meal planning! Tons of recipe and diet options and the fact that they make the grocery lists for you is amazing. Do it- you won’t regret it!

title: Life Changing App, Super Responsive Support
body: I bought this app five years ago when I needed help planning and following a restricted diet. It was a game changer then...meal planning and shopping got monumentally easier. I no longer need the restricted diet...no problem for the app. Change my preference settings to include previously restricted foods, bam! New plan. Fast forward five years to a pandemic. I’d have to manually type my grocery list into a store app to place a pickup order. I asked for a grocery store integration. One existed, but the integrated service wouldn’t deliver to me. Waited a month or so, and Bam! Another grocery delivery integration that DOES deliver to me! The developers of this app listen to their clients. Customer support is amazing. Chat is always available to answer questions. Yes, it’s a subscription service. But the money I have saved by eliminating food waste (don’t buy what I don’t need), and the time I save trying to figure out what’s for dinner has been life changing. Have a favorite recipe that’s not in the planner? No problem! You can either type it in manually or imported it seamlessly from the internet. I don’t typically write reviews or make recommendations, but I tell everyone I know about this app, I love it that much.

title: Awesome app!!! Developers listen too!
body: The app has some good meals. The planning is relatively easy to use. The grocery list I like. The app is agonizingly slow to go from on screen to another. Cute pot with hearts popping up out of it while you wait, but has turned into annoying. And this isn’t because of wifi or cell service. This has occurred in many locations with many level of bars. I’m updating my stars from 3 to 5. The app’s improvements have remedied the issue of being slow. Works like a charm!!!

title: I love Real Plans ❤️
body: It is truly amazing what Real Plans can do for your meal planning, grocery shopping and meal preparation. I’ve been using Real Plans for over a year now and I’m learning new things it can do all the time. Well done Real Plans!

title: Stress reliever! Connects to Instacart!
body: What a time saver. After my meal plan is created, I’m able to import the ingredients to my instacart!! Also I love how Real plans can record an inventory of what is in your fridge, pantry, and suggest recipes based on that. And suggests ingredients to get to unlock more recipes! Plus, I can just type in a food I detest (jalapeños) and a whole bunch of items come up that I can easily select all and add to “never include a recipe with this” (or something to that effect.) And I like that I can plan in leftovers! The recipes so far have been delicious. I will update my preference to be faster recipes with fewer ingredients. Cool option. Very user friendly site. So worth $14 a month to not have to wonder at dinner time what I’m going to cook. And the kids love the food!!!

title: Best thing ever
body: This app has changed my life! We are a family of six, and dinner used to be my enemy! Now, I just shop once a week and know I have everything I need for every meal in my fridge. The food is delicious and my family is stoked. I love it so much I could cry!

title: Helps a lot when trying to eat three meals a day
body: I have trouble eating all three main meals of the day and with an active lifestyle, Ive run into trouble. RealPlans has helped me plan my meals beforehand to fit eating into my schedule again.

title: Life Saver for those with allergies
body: Getting instantly updated meal plans, recipes, and shopping lists that fit our crazy assortment of allergies and preferences has changed our lives! We went from eating out 3 or 4 times a week to rarely doing so, and love the food so much more. You can also access your account online, I actually prefer looking everything over and taking advantage of all the options there, then using the app to shop and access my recipes in the kitchen. But you can do it all on the app as well. Customer service is super responsive!

title: If apps were food, this one would be yummy.
body: Beautiful setup. It’s nice to look at, user friendly, easy to navigate and makes doing Whole30 SOOOO much easier. Especially as a busy mom of two under two who is desperate to be healthy but can’t quite muster the brain power to find recipes, meal plan and meal prep. It does an incredible amount of the work for me, removing 90 percent of the stress involved with the age old “what’s for dinner?” question. It’s brilliant and impressive in myriad ways. My one complaint is that it stopped loading my grocery list mid-shopping trip today (first time out the gate). This sucked, but I would hate to fault the app if in reality it had to do with my internet connection :/

title: Truly a benefit for the beginner
body: This app is truly a big benefit for the beginner (me) that is committed to better health and scheduled planning. I truly enjoy the shopping list with the convenience of delivery or picking up myself. Reduces the overwhelming aspects of what and when to thaw, and cook as well as the capability of customizing the menu to exclude food items.Thank you! Wish me success on my Whole30 journey.

title: Autoimmune Options
body: I was overwhelmed when I received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease four months ago. I immediately began to research my options and discovered autoimmunewellness.com, which led me to your app. It has saved so much time! Rather than scouring the web for recipes, I was able to get on the path of recovery much sooner!

title: Most Efficient Way To Meal Plan
body: What an awesome resource this has been for me! It has been an incredible time saber for me. The fact that you it only feeds you recipes with ingredients that meet the needs for all my dietary restrictions. There are still over a thousand recipes that feed into my weekly meals plans, even with all my restrictions. I don’t have to put any thought into it. It’s simple to change a recipe on your plan, and it’s also slick to upload your own recipes.

title: Love it!!!
body: Real Plans makes my life sooo much easier!! I work full time but still want decent meals and an organized way of living. Real Plans helps me accomplish this. I love having my grocery list all ready for me on my phone too. No paper list to remember and needing a pen handy in my purse. Real Plans is SO worth it!!

title: Best Plan I’ve Ever Used
body: This is the most comprehensive and thorough plan I’ve ever tried. It offers meal plans for every diet preference from omnivores to vegan Keto. I love that counts your calories, gives nutritional information and writes your shopping list. I was worried that the shopping list would get too expensive, but it matched my usual cost, except it’s filled with real foods instead of processed. Love it!

title: Great app
body: I love this App. I like to set up my weekly schedules on the website and use my phone for the recipes and grocery list. The only thing I don’t like is that they recently changed the format of the app and website. I hate what they changed it too. I preferred the older version.

title: Best food planner ever!
body: This app has all the flexibility and customization I’ve been looking for! You can adjust servings, change meal schedules on the fly, AND add your own recipes (plus they have tons of recipes included). It compiles your grocery list and gives you a timeline to prep meals. Customer service response time is quick to answer any questions. I finally have my meals under control so I’m not starving and overeat! Worth every penny!

title: Absolutely worth it
body: This app and the website are fantastic! It works like a dream, and I love that I can tag recipes so I can cycle by food family (for LEAP), and upload and edit my own recipes (so I can SCD-ize recipes). The auto-shopping list and timeline features are really useful. I’m also really impressed by the customer service!

title: Brilliant contribution to making lives better
body: Thank you, thank you, thank you. I have been needing this for 20 years. I am a health focused, wife, business owner, parent of 3 busy kids and teens - one with celiac disease and meal planning has absolutely overwhelmed me. I actually like cooking - but I never learned the tricks when I was younger - and I haven’t figured out how to get it all planned out, shopped for and then to have enough consistent energy to get it all done on a regular basis. This program takes away the hard first steps - the planning, deciding and picking things everyone will eat, writing out the shopping list, organizing it then timing everything so that it works with our schedule and advance prep. Well, before this program, I just couldn’t get it all together more often than once in a blue moon...Or... I would buy all the ingredients for a variety of meals and half the ingredients would sit in the fridge unused b/c I came home too exhausted from work or realized that our schedule had changed. This program breaks everything down into easy steps and takes away the need for professional like experience and mental gymnastics. Thank you!!! You have a giant fan here (hehe - and if you want an investor - I’m your gal).

title: Time saver
body: The 24 hour customer service is amazing. They actually know the recipes and can answer tech questions or cooking questions. I use this app for my weekly meal planning and shopping and for party and holiday planning.

title: Mind Blowing
body: It’s what I’ve been looking for, but didn’t know it. I’ve been toying with the idea of those boxes that include the food, but didn’t like the idea of not choosing my own produce. Plus the prices didn’t seem reasonable. This app has just taken the thinking out of it for me. It plans my week, based on my dietary interests, it sends my shopping list to me (which I can edit), and it reminds me to begin cooking. The only suggested upgrades I would add would be to make the link with your calendar a bit more savvy - so that it takes into account cooking time and things that need to be soaked the night before. So, for example, if I have it set that I want to eat at 6pm, I would notify me when to start cooking for the recipe I have chosen (they include cook times). Likewise, they would notify me the night before if the mornings recipe needs the beans soaked prior. Otherwise, awesome. And they have on call support (so says an email I received, but I have not yet tried it). The recipes so far have all been good to outstanding. And, more important, toddler approved (although I do occasionally have to cut back on the garlic and hot peppers).

title: I love this app!
body: I’m 62 and tried of trying to decide what to cook for the week. I’ve had no problems with this app. I use the chat function if I have a question. They are always helpful. There is a Facebook group for those of us who like to share. This app has gotten me out of my culinary rut. I love that I can go in and out of food plans, add my favorite food blogger recipes, and switch out what doesn’t suit my family’s tastes. I can purchase more recipes from well known food personalities for less that the price of another cookbook. My daughter is a vegetarian and my husband and I eat a Paleo/Primal Diet. I can keep the whole family fed and happy. The shopping list helps keep me from impulse buying, so there is a lot less food wasted in the refrigerator. I couldn’t be happier.

title: Worth every penny
body: This app has been life changing for me and my husband. After personally struggling with weight and feeling terrible for years - I finally found answers when I was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease - Hashimotos. The first order from my endocrinologist was to change EVERYTHING I thought I knew about food and go Whole30, some Paleo, DF, and GF...FOR LIFE - as in a total lifestyle change. I went to Pinterest for recipes but was concerned that some of the ideas to pin weren't Whole30 approved. I was right. So I spent time on the Whole30 site and found Real Plans. I was unsure at first with a subscription charge..but I can assure you I'd be LOST without this app. From the roulette wheel of customizing dinner plans, adjusting servings to accommodate for left overs, and the grocery list - real plans is a necessary toolkit for making a truly healthy lifestyle change.

title: Great way to organize
body: I like this app but for other reasons I cancelled my subscription and the customer service chat was very helpful helping me cancel. I will use this app again in the future !

title: Life Saver
body: This app absolutely saved me and a friend during Whole30! Made food prep and planning easy & fun! I love that you can easily select or just the diet or meal plan you are following.

title: Absolutely awesome and life changing app!
body: This is the BEST app there is for healthy meal planning. Every recipe I have tried has been fabulous! Not to mention the ease of setting customizations to cater to your lifestyle. Absolutely incredible app!

title: Makes planning, shopping and cooking Whole 30 easier
body: This is my first time using a meal planning app, so I have nothing to compare to other than my previous system of looking for recipes online or in cookbooks and writing out a list. This app is saving me a lot of time because I customized it to my eating plan (Whole 30) and it selects the recipes for me. I usually stick to at least half of the recommendations and then I can shuffle the rest to suit myself. The time line and shopping list help keep me on track and focused. I love it!

title: Absolutely amazing
body: I can not express how great this app is. Everything is so easy to use and well laid out. I love that it takes the pressure off of me from trying to pick out meals every day. I especially love that it provides a shopping list with the correct amounts needed based on the recipe serving sizes that I chose. Genius!

title: Best Meal Plan App EVER!!
body: My favorite features are the super easy import recipe function and separating my grocery list by the stores I assign to where I usually buy the items at. I love how I can even permanently change their recipes so like if I hate fish then I can change the recipe to call for chicken and it will stay way. Also love how I can exclude things by groups, like for Whole30, or by ingredient like okra. Now if they only had a feature that allowed my meal plan to sinc with a calorie counting/fitness app like MyFitnessPal. Then, it would be PERFECT! This app is for a service that has a subscription plan. They offer monthly, quarterly, and annual options. They have a money back guarantee if you don't love it but I guarantee you will! They also allowed me to upgrade when I chose quarterly but really wanted to keep it and have the savings of the annual plan. Plus, their customer service is phenomenal. Day or night someone is available for chat and they always know what they are talking about and can help.

title: Dinner Winner!
body: I love this service and the app is absolutely out of this world! It is so user-friendly to change your menu around, shopping list that can be fine-tuned for the different stores that I shop at and great recipes that my family will eat! Can't ask for more than that :) Plus the customer service is top notch to boot!

title: Not just for recipes...
body: This app is an amazing tool to have in your life. Great add-in only if wanted. The recipes that are part of the basic app are great and the customizable aspects of each recipe are great for changing number of servings and ingredients. I feel like the developers truly care and personally address every concern or question. The on-line Facebook community is supportive and provides lots of additional ideas for customizing.

title: best app!
body: I love this app. It's so easy to use and the upgrades over the last year or so have breen amazing. I've been using it since before its inception (when it was just emailed pdfs) and it's been game changing for planning meals. I can access and update my meal plans anytime. The meals are amazing. The best part about the app? The cusotmer service available to all customers is by far the best customer service I've ever experienced anywhere. They are extremely kind and helpful. I highly recommend this app to anyone looking to eat clean and healthy.

title: Takes recipe apps 10 steps further
body: I absolutely love this app and the ability to select recipes based on my daughter's customized elimination diet. It's genius! I tried it for a month, actually used and decided to purchase for the year. I dealt with their customer support and they responded quickly and handled everything perfectly. Their follow up was perfect. I highly recommend this app.

title: Change my life!
body: Real Plans is such an amazing service. This app is fantastic- they've worked so hard to create a user friendly app. Customer service that comes along with the membership is top notch. The shopping list feature is by far my favorite feature of this app. I can access my shopping list anywhere and don't worry whether or not I've picked up everything I need for the week.

title: Fabulous app
body: Easy to use app with detailed options I haven't found on any other meal planner. Accessible for different diet choices and needs, including my own personal recipes. Customer Service is incredible and immediately available via online chat. Highly recommend!!!

title: Helped me rock my Whole 30
body: I'm new to meal planning, but Real Plans has helped me rock my Whole 30. I'm a working mom with young kids, so knowing what I'm doing once I hit the kitchen in the evening is immensely helpful.

title: Makes dinnertime SO much easier
body: This app has everything I need to get real food on the table- delicious recipes, a shopping list to check off in stores and even live chat if I need help. Thanks Real Plans!

title: Beautiful app
body: This app is beautiful. It functions almost exactly like the website and is I sync with my online account every time. Shopping is a breeze, and I can modify my entire plan with one hand on the go! I love this app!

title: Love this service!
body: App is easy to use & is supported SO WELL. I've never seen customer support like these guys. That includes making improvements to the app based on customer feedback. Love the program. Love the app.

title: Amazing!!
body: Love the app, saves me time and it has great recipes! Lots of great features!

title: Love this app!
body: Meal planning is the only way we keep ourselves on track. Otherwise, we end up with take out every night. This app has the best shopping list I've found in an app before. I also like that I can import a recipe from the app too. Any time I've had an issue, their customer service through chat has been amazingly helpful!

title: If I could only have one app it would be this one.
body: I'm a busy mom who wants to feed her family real food. I don't have time to sift through Pinterest and cookbooks to find recipes that meat that could criteria. I don't have to with this app. This app: saves time is easy to use Contains yummy, yet healthy recipes Can be modified to fit my schedule, diet, and even budget Offers immediate help when I have a question about the app or a recipe This app and meal plan subscription is totally worth the money. I can meal plan with one hand on my phone during one nursing session. Meal plans are created for me and I can modify as needed. The creators of real plans really thought of it all when they developed this app and meal planning service.

title: The BEST Meal Planning App Imaginable
body: I love this app. You get hundreds of recipes pre-loaded. You can add hundreds more recipes on the cheap from WellnessMama, NomNom Paleo, Whole 360, and more. You can set all kinds of preferences: How much time do you want to take preparing each meal of the week? Set it. Food allergies? Set it. Then it creates a shopping list for you that you can check off while you shop. And the items are sorted by grocery store area. That means one single stop at each section of the store and no more wandering around like an idiot. Score! Then you have step by step directions. Does your real food recipe require prep? This app has a schedule to tell you when to thaw meat each day, when to make broth, etc, so you're always ready to go with no surprises. Best part? They're always updating it so I get new features added on each year. This is the only meal planning app I'll ever need.

title: LOVE!
body: The selection of recipes and the easy user interface make this app a must have for healthy meal planning!

title: Superb meal planner
body: This app is changed way of planning the meal👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻

title: Improved our quality of life
body: I am a homeschooling mother/aunt of our11 yo, and our 16 nephew. I also work every single weekend as our local visiting nurses association's weekend manager. I run our household, and try to make über nourishing food for a paleo eater, a vegetarian, and two mostly paleo kids. I was so stressed about meals, shopping, prepping, and batch cooking. When I found Real Plans I was thrilled! I am not yet up to what I consider full speed, but am getting there and am using the app more and more. I LOVE that nomnompaleo recipes are now an add on pack, and I hear The Paleo Mom is joining Real Plans too!!

title: Love this meal plan!
body: Helps me have peaceful organized trips to the store and saves me money!

title: Perfect synergy
body: This app is amazing. I have allergies to eggs, dairy and soy. It's been so frustrating to find a recipe only to realize it is based on one of those ingredients. This amazing app has given me the freedom and ease of mind I've been searching for!! I've used other apps but this one pulls all the pieces together. I added Nom Nom Paleo to the recipe mix and this has been pure joy. I'm so very grateful to find a resource that does it all - I shopped with the list generated with no muss, no fuss. And the developers are terrific - they truly care and have a melange of knowledge and skills to craft an app that's a true delight to use. I'm hoping for Apple Watch integration.
